decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on the firm's existing plugin development and analytics expertise, and GA4 is now the mandatory Google standard, so demand from shop clients will last.
Google stopped processing data for Universal Analytics in 2023 and 2024, so the plugin loses its purpose and the firm's analytics knowledge is better applied to the GA4 successor.
The retail system interface plugin draws on the firm's core competence in interfaces and plugins, and it supports ongoing client integrations whose results the firm can interpret and improve.
Relaunch SEO support combines the firm's proven relaunch project experience with its search marketing know-how, and it has a page of its own, which signals strategic commitment.
